summary: Added the control that distinguishes the applicability of the asserted growth defect, since a competing explanation was that the accumulation is merely transient. The harness now also runs the same same-context retry pattern with CheckQuorum enabled over three voters and ticks through an election timeout: a local run shows the window does close (after three ticks the node is StateFollower with 24 queued read requests accumulated), but nothing is reclaimed - eight further retries after the step-down leave the queue unchanged (pending_after=24, pending_unchanged=true, unconfirmed 0). That refines the claim in two directions: CheckQuorum bounds the growth window to roughly one election timeout, and the retention half of the defect is independent of CheckQuorum. Submitted as a successor experiment for the same investigation with prerequisite and comparison records (window_closed==true for the before event, pending_unchanged==true for the after event); the interpretation will be revised once the controller produces the receipt.
